The second pathway connects Neogitogenin to CAKI-2, which is targeted by Acetyldeschloroelatol, also leading to SQ20B. These two distinct routes suggest that Neogitogenin may act through different molecular mechanisms to influence SQ20B. The evidence supports a potential functional relationship between Neogitogenin and SQ20B, though the exact mechanism by which Neogitogenin affects SQ20B remains unclear. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the interaction network, emphasizing the need for further investigation into the specific molecular interactions involved.
